expectations.description: Seven explicitly seeded entitlement states are exercised through 21 real project reads and seven member identity reads. Active and trialing future-paid teams project premium access; past_due with future paid_until does not. Recent expiry and recent cancellation allow member/viewer metadata reads with canWrite false; dates safely beyond the 30-day grace window refuse those reads with exact 402 and omit the project from member identity. The owner reads the existing project in every state. canWrite assertions concern public capability projection, not document-write execution.

Cancellation time takes precedence over paid_until for grace: recent canceled_at with 31-day-old paid_until allows member/viewer reads, whereas 31-day-old canceled_at with recent paid_until refuses them. With canceled_at null, old paid_until refuses them. The real clock is not altered and exact equality at the expiry boundary is not tested. All declared business rows remain unchanged by each phase of reads and refused creates.

Across seven states, member identity retains exactly its team with matching role/status; plan is team only for active/trialing with future paid_until and free for the other five states. Project-list membership and capability projections match the phase expectations.

Public project GET responses preserve all original project fields and expose exact owner/member/viewer role, phase premium and projected canWrite. Owner canWrite stays true; member canWrite is true only in the two premium states, and viewer canWrite stays false. This does not execute document writes.

Owner metadata reads succeed in all seven entitlement states even when member/viewer reads are refused. The final owner project list still contains the original unarchived project with premium false and canWrite true after grace expires.

Member identity contains exactly the new active project during premium/grace states and no projects in the two expired-grace states; original archived project is never returned. Team membership and identity remain visible. All declared business rows remain unchanged.

A member new-project POST in active-expired grace and an owner new-project POST in canceled expired grace each returns exact 402/team_subscription_required. Fresh project IDs prevent an idempotent replay short circuit, and all declared business rows remain exact.

A member cannot create a new team project while active entitlement is expired, and the owner cannot create one after canceled grace has expired; both return exact 402 without business-row changes. Nevertheless, after grace the owner can list and archive the existing team project. Archive changes only that project archived_at and updated_at within request time; owner list then omits it and direct owner lookup is 404. Restoring the three fixture entitlement fields and leaving through real membership routes restores all original declared rows, with only the new archived project retained.

After grace expires, the public owner DELETE archives the existing project. Read-only D1 comparison shows archived_at bounded by the request and updated_at equal to archived_at; all other project fields and business rows remain equal. Public listing becomes empty and direct lookup is 404. The three entitlement fixture fields receive no source credit.
